Final categorization: REVIEW  
(Justification: The paper is explicitly labeled as a "Review article" and synthesizes global research on climate change impacts on wine production, including shifts in the geographic suitability of winegrowing regions under future climate scenarios. It discusses emerging and declining viticultural areas—effectively addressing land use/land cover (LULC) changes related to vineyard expansion or abandonment—but does not conduct original spatial modeling or national-scale LULC prediction. Instead, it reviews and integrates findings from existing studies (e.g., referencing Fig. 1 based on prior suitability assessments). Since the review touches on LULC future prediction (e.g., “49–70% of existing wine regions” at risk, emergence of new regions at higher latitudes/altitudes, implications of viticultural expansion into natural areas), it meets the criterion for 'REVIEW' under the categorization flow.)
